beats.label: S1 · Newcomer with a secret
beats.text: Jane arrives in Monterey with son Ziggy, befriending Madeline and Celeste; on Ziggy's first day of school Amabella accuses him of choking her, which he denies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the outsider whose backstory drives the whole season and sets up the Ziggy/Amabella bullying dispute that pulls the mothers into orbit around each other.

beats.label: S1 · Perry behind closed doors
beats.text: Celeste seems to have a perfect marriage, but Perry beats her in private; her therapist recognises the pattern and urges her to plan a way out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the abuse that Celeste is hiding from everyone, the therapist relationship that drives her arc, and the fact that Perry is dangerous long before anyone else sees it.

beats.label: S1 · Madeline's affair resurfaces
beats.text: Madeline resumes flirting with old lover Joseph; a car crash after they argue lands him in hospital and nearly exposes the affair to Ed and Joseph's wife Tori.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants Madeline's secret that will detonate her marriage in the next season; the crash is the moment it stops being containable.

beats.label: S1 · Hunting a rapist
beats.text: Jane confides that Ziggy was the product of rape by a 'Saxon Banks'; Madeline finds a lookalike, but Jane's confrontation with him confirms he is the wrong man.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The women now share Jane's secret and the actual rapist is still out there — this is the loaded gun that goes off at trivia night.

beats.label: S1 · Celeste plans her escape
beats.text: After Perry threatens to kill her during another beating, Celeste secretly rents an apartment and plans to leave with the twins the day after trivia night.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The escape plan is what Perry catches wind of at the party — it is the direct trigger for his final attack on Celeste.

beats.label: S1 · The real bully
beats.text: Ziggy tells Jane that Celeste's son Max has been bullying Amabella, copying Perry's violence; Celeste realises what her sons have already learned from their father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the season-long bullying question in a way that reframes Celeste's whole family and sets up her fight to raise the twins away from Perry's legacy.

beats.label: S1 · The stairs at trivia night
beats.text: At trivia night Jane recognises Perry as her rapist; when Perry attacks Celeste, Bonnie shoves him down the stairs, and the five women tell the police he tripped.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The event the whole show has been walking toward — Perry dead, the rapist question answered, and five women bonded by a lie that becomes the next season's engine.

cliffhanger.text: Perry is dead on the stairs at trivia night, and Madeline, Celeste, Jane, Renata and Bonnie have told the police he tripped. Detective Quinlan does not believe them, and only Bonnie knows she pushed him.
questions: How long can five women hold the same lie together?
Will Detective Quinlan find the crack in the story?
What does Bonnie do with the fact that she is the one who actually killed him?

characters.name: Celeste Wright
characters.line: Retired lawyer and mother of twins Max and Josh; her secretly abusive marriage to Perry has just ended with his death at trivia night.

characters.name: Madeline Mackenzie
characters.line: Wealthy alpha mother of Chloe and Abigail; she resumed and ended an affair with Joseph, and husband Ed does not yet know she cheated.

characters.name: Jane Chapman
characters.line: Single mother of Ziggy, new to Monterey; she has just recognised Perry as the man who raped her and fathered her son.

characters.name: Bonnie Carlson
characters.line: Nathan's second wife and yoga instructor; she pushed Perry down the stairs to protect the others and has told no one it was not an accident.

characters.name: Renata Klein
characters.line: Wealthy tech executive and mother of Amabella; Madeline's rival for most of the season, now bound to the group by the lie about Perry.

characters.name: Perry Wright
characters.line: Celeste's charming, violent husband and — unknown to Celeste — the stranger who raped Jane seven years earlier; killed by Bonnie at trivia night.

characters.name: Ed Mackenzie
characters.line: Madeline's steady second husband and Chloe's father; suspicious of Joseph but does not yet know Madeline slept with him.

characters.name: Detective Quinlan
characters.line: The Monterey detective who does not believe the group's 'he tripped' account and is quietly watching the five women.

beats.label: S2 · Mary Louise arrives
beats.text: Perry's mother Mary Louise moves in with Celeste, refusing to believe her son was an abuser and pressing everyone for the truth about how he died.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's antagonist and the pressure that will force Perry's abuse and Jane's rape into the open — she is the wedge that reopens every wound from S1.

beats.label: S2 · Bonnie unravels
beats.text: Bonnie grows distant from Nathan, sick with guilt over killing Perry; her estranged mother arrives and begins glimpsing visions of Bonnie drowning.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the internal collapse that drives Bonnie's arc all season and ends with her decision to confess.

beats.label: S2 · The Kleins collapse
beats.text: Gordon is arrested for fraud and the Kleins go bankrupt; Renata rages at him publicly while Amabella has panic attacks about the collapsing world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sends Renata's storyline in an entirely new direction — she ends the season broke and without Gordon, a full inversion of her S1 position.

beats.label: S2 · The affair comes out
beats.text: Ed discovers Madeline slept with Joseph; the marriage fractures into therapy, and Joseph's wife Tori tries to seduce Ed in revenge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cashes in the loaded gun from S1 and defines Madeline and Ed's whole season — everything after this is them trying to decide whether the marriage survives.

beats.label: S2 · Mary Louise sues for custody
beats.text: Convinced Celeste is a negligent mother, Mary Louise files for custody of Max and Josh; the trial forces Celeste to defend her marriage to Perry in open court.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The custody suit is the machinery that drags every S1 secret about Perry into a courtroom and back into the group's lives.

beats.label: S2 · Celeste destroys Mary Louise
beats.text: On the stand Celeste plays a video of Perry beating her, wins full custody, and Mary Louise leaves Monterey for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the custody plot and puts Celeste's abuse on the public record — Perry is now definitively named as what he was.

beats.label: S2 · The five walk into the station
beats.text: Ed and Madeline renew their vows and Renata leaves Gordon; then Bonnie texts the others she is going to confess, and the four drive her to the police station.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's final image — every woman has just reshuffled her life, and now the S1 lie is about to come apart on their terms.

cliffhanger.text: Bonnie has texted the others that she is going to confess to killing Perry, and Madeline, Celeste, Jane and Renata are walking into the Monterey police station beside her. Nobody has agreed on what any of them will actually say when they get inside.
questions: Does Bonnie go through with the confession, or does the group pull her back?
Do the other four back her story or protect themselves?
Can any of these marriages and friendships survive what Bonnie is about to put on the record?

characters.name: Bonnie Carlson
characters.line: Consumed by guilt over killing Perry, emotionally checked out of her marriage to Nathan, and about to confess to the police.

characters.name: Celeste Wright
characters.line: Widowed and struggling with Ambien and grief; she won the custody trial by putting her own abuse on public record.

characters.name: Madeline Mackenzie
characters.line: Her affair with Joseph came out to Ed early in the season; after therapy and near-collapse they have renewed their vows.

characters.name: Jane Chapman
characters.line: In her first tentative relationship since the rape, dating co-worker Corey; she has told Ziggy how he was conceived.

characters.name: Renata Klein
characters.line: Ruined financially by Gordon's fraud conviction; she has just destroyed his prized train set and walked out of the marriage.

characters.name: Mary Louise Wright
characters.line: Perry's mother, who moved to Monterey convinced Celeste was hiding the truth about his death; she lost the custody case and has left.

characters.name: Ed Mackenzie
characters.line: Devastated when he learned of the affair and briefly tempted by Tori; he chose to forgive Madeline and they renewed their vows.

characters.name: Detective Quinlan
characters.line: Still working the Perry case; her questioning of Jane's boyfriend Corey is part of what has pushed Bonnie toward confessing.
